xp_shop.source: Mythic 7.0 CU1 - Spending Experience (p. 51), Languages (p. 10), Skills (p. 90), Abilities (p. 97), Educations (p. 105), ORION Soldier (p. 59)
notes: Experience should only be spent during downtime between Missions or at a checkpoint chosen by the GM.
Everything in this file is available to both Core and Light & Sky characters.

characteristic_advancements.rule: Characteristic Advancements are +5 upgrades that can be taken up to 5 times for each Characteristic. The previous Advancement must always be taken first. Advancements unlocked through Character Creation don't need to be purchased.

luck.rule: Players can gain +1 Luck by spending 1,500 Experience, up to a maximum of 13 Luck.

wound_upgrades.rule: Each Wound Upgrade gives +10 Wounds. The previous Wound Upgrade Tier must be purchased before the next can be taken.

faction_training.rule: Faction Training costs 300 Experience regardless of the Faction. Covenant Faction Training also covers Banished weapons. The GM should only allow Forerunner Faction Training with good reason.

languages.rule: All Characters begin with one Language for free. Characters can learn up to their Intellect Modifier in Languages; each costs 150 Experience.

educations.rule: Spend the +5 cost to learn an Education, then the +10 cost to improve it. Characters can learn up to double their Intellect Modifier in Educations; the +10 version does not count against the limit.
educations.restricted_rule: Restricted Educations (marked *) need GM permission. A Character who isn't supposed to know about one must spend 3 times the listed Experience cost.

skills.rule: A Skill is first bought at Trained, then upgraded to +10 and +20. You can't upgrade a Skill you do not own.

abilities.rule: Abilities are bought with Experience once their Prerequisites are met. The Prerequisite is only needed to acquire the Ability.

soldier_type_upgrades.name: ORION Augmentation
soldier_type_upgrades.time: 1 month of augmentation and 1 month of recovery
soldier_type_upgrades.rule: Any regular Human can become an ORION Soldier. They gain +10 Strength and Agility and +15 Toughness and Perception (these don't use Characteristic Advancements), the ORION Mythic Characteristics, and +20 to Toughness Tests against the Flood.

light_and_sky_xp_shop.source: Light and Sky - Connections, Light Aspects, Light Abilities, Supers (pp. 4-5)
notes: Light & Sky purchases are only available to Light & Sky characters.
Connection, Aspect Slot, Ability Slot and Super costs come from data/light_and_sky.

connections.rule: Once the Character has earned at least 2,000 Experience they can purchase up to 4 additional Connections, including Darkness and Specialized Connections. Specialized Connections need a Light and a Darkness Connection, and the GM decides whether the Character has met the remaining conditions.

prismatic.rule: With Prismatic, the Character no longer pays extra Experience for Light Aspects that don't match their Connection, and all extra Experience already spent that way is refunded.

light_weapon.rule: Light Weapon is a universal Light Ability; its Super version costs +50% Experience like any other Super. Weapon effects are chosen with the GM when the weapon is formed.
